Your holdings:

Watch:
Keep a close eye on how the broader market reacts to the weak labor numbers, especially for any further pressure on tech. Also, monitor your stops on SOXL and SPAL.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions given the current macro headwinds.
